description: Unit tests for the RelationshipValidator class in the OpenMRS API, specifically testing validation logic for date fields, field length constraints, and error handling in relationship objects.

classes.name: RelationshipValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the RelationshipValidator class, covering validation scenarios such as date consistency, field length, and validation of start date in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEndDateIsBeforeStartDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the relationship's end date is before the start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfEndDateIsAfterStartDate
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when the end date is after the start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when field lengths are within allowed limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the void reason exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfStartDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Validates that the validator flags an error if the start date is set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateIsNotInFuture
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if the start date is in the past or present.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that validation passes if the start date field is null.
